text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm on my way to the student council office to deliver some documents Symboli Rudolf asked for, when…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer, it's you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ah, Teio's trainer. If you're looking for the president, she ought to be back shortly.
choice_data_list: I don't mind waiting around a bit.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, you might as well watch our chess match! I'm just about to whoop Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmph. Nonsense. There is not the slightest chance of that happening.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Nuh-uh! Today's the day I win!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Plus, Prez said I could run with her if I do!
choice_data_list: Refine your strategy, then show her what you're made of!
Refine your strategy, then show her what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Plus, Prez said I could run with her if I do!
choice_data_list: Refine your strategy, then show her what you're made of!
Refine your strategy, then show her what you're made of!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What do you mean?! At least be a little more encouraging, like, "You've got this in the bag!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ouch, didn't think my own trainer would be so brutal!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Whatever! I'm gonna win whether you believe in me or not!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehehe! And now your pesky little queen is outta the picture!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You two better be watching closely! I'm sitting on the cusp of victory here!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Are you quite sure of that?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Teio, I applaud your intelligence.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, when you fall victim to your own hubris, your concentration invariably falters.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: The time has come to turn the tables. I shall move my bishop here.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?! Whoa, whoa, whoa!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: So you realize your mistake. Good. Now, I am on track to put you in checkmate next turn. Do you have a strategy?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I… Ughhh, I give up.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Ah, a classic queen sacrifice. Beautifully done, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: How unfortunate, Teio. It appears that you snatched defeat from the jaws of victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Tokai… KO'd?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Oh, I see. You've switched "Teio" with "KO'd" because she lost… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Prez! Don't laugh at me!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: O-oh, I apologize. Your trainer's wordplay was just so brilliant…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf is unable to quell her chuckling, and Tokai Teio storms out of the room in a huff.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I know just the thing!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll have you know, I've been playing chess since I was little!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Not even my parents stood a chance against me!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then let's see you prove that those victories weren't simply your parents going easy on you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Show your trainer that you can overcome the might of the Empress!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ughhh…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: (I guess this was never gonna be an easy win, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Forfeiting is always an option, you know. I expect the president will return shortly, so it'd be a good time to wrap things up.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No, no, no! I won't give up!
choice_data_list: At times like these, it's important to keep a cool head.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right. Thanks, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: (Keep it together, Teio! Think—what's her playstyle? What tactics has she used so far?)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: (She pins me down whether I steel my defenses or mount an assault. And I can't break free 'cause she's outmaneuvering me at every turn.)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: (If I wanna win, I gotta surpass the "Empress" and set my own pace! I'll lay a trap for her!)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: …Well, well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I-I did it!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: To think that I would be bested. Victory is yours, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: It appears you've found yourself a worthy mentor. I hope you remain diligent in your training.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, what a shame. I was hoping to witness your bout myself.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Prez! Look, look! I beat Air Groove!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, is that so? Then I must keep my word.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Very well. My schedule is open tomorrow. Shall we go running together, Teio?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Let's do it! Hehehe. You're the best, Prez!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio's match with Air Groove not only boosts her confidence, it also reminds her just how important it is to strategize.
